LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Prepare to rediscover a classic. StarCraft Remastered upgrades the original 1997 sci-fi real-time strategy game and its expansion, StarCraft: Brood War. Experience the intergalactic battle between the Terran, Protoss, and Zerg with improved graphics and audio, plus the same classic gameplay that made StarCraft a global phenomenon.

●	Take on challenging missions in three story campaigns that will familiarize you with each of the game’s armies.
●	Easily switch between the retro look of yesteryear and the remastered graphics of the new release.
●	Challenge your friends to throw down old-school, or brave the ranked ladder in competitive online play.
●	Use the game’s map editor to create your own maps and mods.

Discover the story that started it all, and engage in a legendary conflict across the galaxy.
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: Dominate the battlefields of the far-flung future!

Features: Experience the seminal real-time strategy game
Discover an epic scifi saga across three intense story campaigns
Use the StarCraft editor to create custom maps and more
